focus: Truck-rental desks inside the District (one Penske at the Rhode Island Ave Home Depot, one Budget on Blair Rd NW, and five U-Haul stores and dealers in NoMa, Edgewood, Bladensburg Rd, South Capitol St, and Benning Rd), one Budget desk just across the river in Arlington, VA, and two labor-only options with DC addresses
intro: This first Washington, DC page covers truck-rental locations whose official Penske, Budget, and U-Haul pages list a District address — the Rhode Island Ave NE Home Depot Penske desk, Budget on Blair Rd NW, and five U-Haul stores and dealers, mostly in Northeast DC — plus one Budget desk in Arlington, VA that Budget’s own DC search lists next. Two labor-only options with DC addresses are included for people who already have a truck or container. In-District truck rental is thin: Penske and Budget each list only one location inside DC, and Enterprise Truck Rental does not list one at all, so Maryland and Virginia suburbs (not covered here yet) may be your backup. Two U-Haul stores say there is no customer parking. We do not report live truck counts; one-way and cargo-van flags are on only when the location page itself mentions them.

listings.name: Penske Truck Rental at The Home Depot #2583
listings.area: Northeast DC · Rhode Island Ave NE (Brentwood / Edgewood)
listings.address: 901 Rhode Island Ave NE, Washington, DC 20018

hours.notes: Hours from the official Penske location page (Mon–Sat 7:00 AM–8:00 PM, Sun 8:00 AM–8:00 PM). The page lists the street as “901 Rhode Island Ave”; the NE quadrant is added from the Home Depot store number and ZIP. It marks after-hours key drop as open; the printed key-drop instruction mentions a 1st Avenue lot entrance, which appears to be generic text, so confirm the drop location with the branch.

listings.offersNotes: The official page includes a “Reserve a Truck” path and a “Looking for a one-way rental?” prompt with a phone line (1-844-824-6609). It is the only Penske location the Penske locator lists inside the District. Cargo vans appear only in the site-wide menu, not as this location’s inventory, so the cargo-van flag is off.
listings.visitNotes: Open Saturday and Sunday per the location page. Do not treat the reservation page as live inventory.

listings.name: Bellhop — Washington, DC hourly moving labor

hours.notes: Hours from the official Washington, DC page: Mon–Sat 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM EST, Sun 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM EST.

listings.offersNotes: The official DC page offers “Hourly moving help and labor”: “If you don’t need transportation but could use some moving help, Bellhop’s skilled Washington D.C. movers make quick work of loading, unloading, and/or rearranging.” The same page says Bellhop is a federally regulated property broker that connects customers with movers.
listings.visitNotes: Bellhop describes itself as a broker, so the crew may be a partner mover. The page publishes a cancellation policy (free up to 72 hours before the move); read it before booking a last-minute job.
